reason: The QuickStart example trains a CartPole policy-gradient agent on CPU in minutes with no downloads or credentials.
goal: Install PARL's dependencies (paddlepaddle CPU, gym, pygame, parl from the /work/PARL clone or pip) so that `python train.py` in /work/PARL/examples/QuickStart runs to completion on CPU.
